long_biography.plain_text:
Bedzhamov combined private business with prominent governance roles. He was a co-owner of Vneshprombank, chaired Sakhalin Shipping Company and described interests in real estate, engineering, glass production, shipping and mining. For six years through the Sochi Olympic cycle, he led the Russian Bobsleigh Federation and also served as an international federation vice-president.

Vneshprombank lost its licence in January 2016, after which Bedzhamov left Russia. A Russian court later declared him bankrupt and, following a retrial, sentenced him in absentia in 2025. English courts have since considered disputes over his London property and other assets. Vneshprombank’s separate English civil claim alleges his involvement in a large fraud, which he denies. His current affairs therefore centre on insolvency and litigation, not an established operating business that would support a more current commercial characterisation.
